sources.name: FinOps Framework 2026 (Cloud+ scopes)
sources.notes: 2026 Framework revision: mission expanded from 'Value of Cloud' to 'Value of Technology'; introduces FinOps Scopes ('Cloud+') spanning Public Cloud, SaaS, Data Center, Data Cloud Platforms, and a dedicated AI Technology Category with its own capabilities/KPIs/FOCUS alignment. Issued as an annual revision rather than a single version number.

sources.name: FOCUS Specification
sources.notes: FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification. Current version: FOCUS 1.4 (ratified June 4, 2026) — corrects this file's prior entry, which cited 1.3 (Dec 4, 2025) as current. 1.4 adds Invoice Detail and Billing Period datasets and expands the Contract Commitment dataset from 13 to 30 columns. FOCUS 1.2 (May 29, 2025) added SaaS/PaaS normalization.

sources.name: GCP Committed Use Discounts Overview

sources.name: OpenCost
sources.notes: CNCF-incubating open-source Kubernetes cost allocation engine, originally donated by Kubecost. Kubecost (commercial) was acquired by IBM in 2024 and now sits alongside Cloudability and Turbonomic in IBM's FinOps suite; verify current OpenCost governance independence at decision time.

sources.name: Vercel Fluid Compute Active CPU Pricing
sources.notes: Active CPU pricing bills only for CPU time actually executing (not idle/wait time), replacing flat GB-hour duration billing on Fluid compute. Reported up to 90% savings for high-idle-time workloads (e.g. AI inference with I/O wait). Confirms the Vercel function-duration guidance in vendor-billing-guide.md.

sources.name: JCGM 101:2008 - Propagation of distributions using a Monte Carlo method
sources.notes: Primary propagation sequence: assign input distributions, sample input vectors, evaluate the model, and summarize the output distribution; Monte Carlo precision scales with draw count but does not validate the model.

sources.name: Morris 1991 - Factorial Sampling Plans for Preliminary Computational Experiments
sources.notes: Primary source for randomized one-factor-at-a-time trajectories and elementary effects used for factor screening.

sources.name: Kucherenko, Tarantola and Annoni - sensitivity indices with dependent variables
sources.notes: Primary boundary source: ordinary independent-input sensitivity indices do not automatically extend to correlated variables; dependence-aware sampling and indices are separate methods.
